verdict.rationale: License detection and license-policy enforcement are a fair question for a code security scanner, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents vulnerability finding: source-to-sink call chains, CVSS severity, PR checks that fail on a severity threshold, and auto-fix PRs. Nothing mentions detecting dependency licenses or enforcing license policies, and the severity-based PR gating is an adjacent control, not license enforcement.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans
